name: Service Account (JWT) private key
description: The private key of the deprecated Adobe Service Account (JWT) credential, paired with a public certificate to generate access tokens; end of life on 2025-06-30.

blockers.summary: No Adobe page read states an encoding, header label or length for the locally generated private key file.
The date a given JWT exchange last succeeded would need a retired credential and a live attempt, which desk research does not make.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
